name: IPAM Lite
description: Full IP address space management. See every IP in each subnet at a glance — available, dynamic lease, reserved, or statically assigned. Track ownership, notes, and assignment history.
author: Matthew Thibodeau
db_migrations: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_static_entries (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL UNIQUE, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), notes TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ipam_assignment_history (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, subnet_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), owner VARCHAR(100), action VARCHAR(20), acted_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, acted_by VARCHAR(100))
